Alan’s festival · SENTENCE STRIPS

Use the two word decks and pictures for matching. Personal choices have no wrong answer.

My name is Alan.
我叫艾伦。
What’s your favorite food?
你最喜欢什么食物？
My favorite food is rice.
我最喜欢的食物是米饭。
My favorite food is pizza.
我最喜欢的食物是比萨饼。
I like apples.
我喜欢苹果。
I love ice cream.
我爱冰淇淋。
That’s my favorite, too!
那也是我最喜欢的！

I SAY, YOU DRAW

Read a prompt. Let Alan draw or arrange the picture cards, then compare together.

Draw an apple.
画一个苹果。
Draw a banana and an orange.
画一根香蕉和一个橙子。
Draw rice and eggs.
画米饭和鸡蛋。
Draw noodles and dumplings.
画面条和饺子。
Draw your favorite food.
画你最喜欢的食物。
